title: invoice
description: Full representation of an invoice, returned by the detail endpoint. A superset of `invoiceSummary`, adding line items, the tax breakdown, currency conversion (FX), the payment history, the approval chain, accounting links, attachments and custom fields.

invoiceNumber.description: Supplier's invoice/credit-note number. Null if not captured.

exportStatus.description: Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`) — an invoice pending approval has nothing to export yet, which is distinct from `pending` (a payable exists but hasn't been exported).

dispute.description: Always null today, even if disputed (`stage` then shows `disputed`).

cancelledAt.description: When the invoice was cancelled/voided, or null if it is still active.

supplier.description: Null only on a draft (`stage` `pendingApproval`) with no supplier set yet.

purchaseOrders.description: Purchase orders this invoice is matched against (two/three-way match). Empty when the invoice references no PO. May hold several when one invoice consolidates multiple POs.

buyer.description: The internal member the invoice is assigned to (the buyer), or null.

costCenter.description: Cost center the invoice is coded to, or null when none is set. Set independently of `analyticalSplits`: the two are not reconciled and can disagree.

analyticalSplits.description: Allocation of the invoice total across cost centers and analytical-field values. Empty when the invoice is not split. Set independently of `costCenter`, so a split can name a different cost center.

expenseCategories.description: Expense categories the invoice is coded to, sorted by name. Empty when none is set. A split invoice can carry several, one per split. These ids are the ones the `expenseCategoryId` filter matches. Only the company's current expense-category field counts: if it is changed or removed, past invoices follow the new setting. A deleted category still shows on the invoices coded to it.

lineItems.description: The invoice's line items — always at least one. A non-itemised invoice is represented as a single line covering the whole amount. Lines carry no accounting coding (see `costCenter` and `analyticalSplits`); line `netAmount`/`taxAmount` sum to the header totals, except when the header total itself is null (draft/incomplete) while real captured line items exist.

netAmount.description: Total before tax, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Can be null in any state, not only draft/incomplete: always for credit notes, and for older invoices whose net amount was never recorded.

taxAmount.description: Total tax, in `currency`'s smallest unit, derived as `grossAmount - netAmount` (not summed from `lineItems`). For the tax-by-rate breakdown (VAT-return view), group the line items by `taxRate`. Null whenever `netAmount` or `grossAmount` is null, so in any state for credit notes and older invoices with no recorded net amount.

grossAmount.description: Total amount including tax (`netAmount` + `taxAmount`), in `currency`'s smallest unit. Positive for invoices (owed to the supplier); negative for credit notes (owed to the company). Null when the invoice has no gross amount yet (draft/incomplete).

amountPaid.description: Amount settled so far, in `currency`'s smallest unit: the sum of `payments` with status `paid` in the invoice `currency` (returned payments and payments in another currency are excluded). When `payments` is empty, it comes from the stored payment status instead: `grossAmount` if `paid`, otherwise 0 (even when `partiallyPaid`). Always 0 on credit notes, which have no stored payment status and never aggregate `payments`. When `grossAmount` is not known yet, it is null if it comes from the stored status (empty `payments`, or a credit note), but is still summed from `payments` when they are recorded.

amountDue.description: Outstanding balance still to be settled (`grossAmount` minus `amountPaid`), in `currency`'s smallest unit. Zero when fully paid. Null when `grossAmount` is not known yet (draft/incomplete).

currency.description: Null only on a draft (`stage` `pendingApproval`) with no currency set yet. Every amount on the invoice is then null too, because an amount can't be stated without its currency.

functionalAmount.description: `grossAmount` converted into the company entity's functional currency, in that currency's smallest unit. For accounting/reporting only — the supplier is paid `grossAmount` in `currency`, not this. Equal to `grossAmount` when the invoice is already in the functional currency. Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`) — this is not known before then, regardless of currency.

functionalCurrency.description: The company entity's functional currency — its primary currency for accounting and reporting. Equals `currency` when no conversion is needed. Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`).

functionalExchangeRate.description: Rate used to convert `currency` into `functionalCurrency`, applied as `functionalAmount` is approximately `grossAmount x functionalExchangeRate`. 1 when both currencies match. Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`).

issueDate.description: Date the supplier issued the invoice, as printed on the document (emission date). Null only on a draft (`stage` `pendingApproval`) with no issue date set yet.

dueDate.description: Date by which the invoice must be paid, per the supplier's payment terms. Null when no due date is known.

accountingDate.description: Posting date — the date the invoice is booked in the accounting ledger, which fixes the fiscal period it falls into. May differ from `issueDate`. Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`). Not the export date; see `exportedAt`.

payments.description: The payment history/plan. Empty until payments exist, and for older invoices not yet backfilled. `paymentStatus`, `amountPaid` and `amountDue` aggregate these entries, except when this array is empty, where they come from the stored payment status, and on credit notes, which have no stored payment status and always report `unpaid`.

review.description: Finance/controller review, or null if none has been recorded.

exportedAt.description: When the invoice was exported to the accounting system, or null if not exported.

documentaryEvidenceStatus.description: Null until the invoice has an accounting payable (see `payableId`) — there is nothing to attach evidence to yet for an invoice pending approval.

payableId.description: Id of the accounting payable this invoice produced, resolvable via the payables API. Null until the invoice has passed approval/controller validation and a payable has been created — not merely "not yet booked" in the accounting sense. One invoice maps to exactly one payable — line items and cost/analytical splits are allocations within that payable, not separate payables; a credit note is a separate document with its own payable.

attachments.description: Supporting files. Any without a download link is omitted, so may be partial.

createdAt.description: When the invoice record was created in Spendesk (ingest/submission time, not the issue date).

updatedAt.description: When any field on the invoice record last changed.

analyticalProperty.description: A value set for one analytical field. Analytical fields are the customer's own bookkeeping dimensions (custom fields) — e.g. project, team — used to classify and report spend. `valueId`/`valueName` are null when the field applies but no value is selected.
analyticalProperty.title: analyticalProperty

approval.description: Detail of the approval workflow — the effective approval chain for this invoice's amount, with its completed, current and upcoming steps. The overall outcome shows in the invoice's `stage`; this object is the breakdown. Only the applicable chain is returned (amount-bracket internals are not exposed).

isAutoApproved.description: Whether the invoice was approved automatically by a rule rather than by approvers. When true, `steps` is empty.

autoApprovalReason.description: Why the invoice was auto-approved, or null when it was not.

steps.description: The approval steps in execution order. Empty when the invoice was auto-approved.

approval.title: approval

approvalDecision.description: Who acted on a step, when, and why. Null on a step until it has been acted on. The outcome (approved vs rejected) is given by the step's `state`.

byUserId.description: Member who took the decision (the acting approver, i.e. the delegate when delegated).

reason.description: Optional note left with the decision (e.g. a denial reason). Null when none.

approvalDecision.title: approvalDecision

approvalStep.description: One step in the approval chain. Steps are returned in execution order (the array index is the position); each must be approved for the invoice to advance to the next.

approvers.description: Members who may act on this step. Usually one; when several are listed, any one of them acting resolves the step.

decision.description: The decision recorded on this step, or null while it is `upcoming`/`current`.

approvalStep.title: approvalStep

approvalStepState.description:
State of a single step within the approval chain. 

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `approved` | This step was approved. |
| `current` | This step is the one awaiting a decision now. |
| `upcoming` | A later step, not yet reached. |
| `rejected` | This step was declined (stops the chain). |
approvalStepState.title: approvalStepState

approver.description: A person entitled to act on an approval step.

userId.description: Member who nominally owns this approval slot (e.g. the reporting manager or cost-center owner). For `type: user` this is the directly-assigned approver.

actingUserId.description: Member acting on the nominal approver's behalf via a delegation. Null when the approval is not delegated (then the acting approver is `userId`).

isDelegated.description: Whether this approval is delegated (`actingUserId` differs from `userId`).

approver.title: approver

approverType.description:
The role by which a person is entitled to approve a step. 

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `reportingManager` | The buyer's reporting manager. |
| `costCenterOwner` | The owner of the invoice's cost center. |
| `accountOwner` | The company's account owner. |
| `user` | A specific named user, assigned directly by an approval rule. |
approverType.title: approverType

buyerRef.description: The internal Spendesk member the invoice is assigned to — the "buyer", i.e. the person the spend is for and who is accountable for it. Distinct from the supplier (the external counterparty). This holds however the invoice was created: a member who submitted it, or the member an automatically-ingested invoice (shared mailbox, API) was assigned to. Name and email may be null for service accounts.
buyerRef.title: buyerRef

costCenterRef.description: Reference to a cost center (the internal unit that bears the cost).

id.description: Cost-center id. Use `GET /v1/cost-centers` to resolve full details.

costCenterRef.title: costCenterRef

currency.description: If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency. Three-letter [ISO currency codes](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html).
currency.title: currency

date.description: String containing a date expressed in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format like `2023-05-12`.
date.title: date

dateTime.description: String containing a UTC datetime expressed in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format like `2023-05-12T14:06:40Z`.
dateTime.title: dateTime

documentaryEvidenceStatus.description:
Status of the supporting document — the supplier's invoice or credit-note file — that justifies the payable for audit and tax purposes. Only meaningful once the invoice has an accounting payable — the invoice's `documentaryEvidenceStatus` field itself is null for invoices that don't have one yet. 

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `provided` | A document is attached. |
| `missing` | No document is attached yet. |
| `cannotBeProvided` | The buyer declared that no document can be provided; a signed affidavit stands in its place. |
| `declaredAsInvalid` | An attached document was reviewed and marked invalid (e.g. wrong file or unreadable). |

Certification/compliance details (e.g. the Spanish "Digitised Paper Receipt") are intentionally out of scope of this field and will be exposed via a dedicated compliance field once its format is finalised.
documentaryEvidenceStatus.title: documentaryEvidenceStatus

expenseCategoryRef.description: Reference to an expense category — the customer's spend taxonomy (e.g. Software, Travel, Meals) used for accounting and analytics. Distinct from the cost center (which bears the cost) and from analytical fields (free custom dimensions).

id.description: Expense-category id. Use `GET /v1/expense-categories` to resolve full details.

expenseCategoryRef.title: expenseCategoryRef

exportStatus.description:
Accounting-export state — whether the invoice has been exported to the customer's accounting system or ERP. Independent of `stage` and `paymentStatus`. The ledger posting date is `accountingDate`; the export timestamp is `exportedAt`. Only meaningful once the invoice has an accounting payable — the invoice's `exportStatus` field itself is null for invoices that don't have one yet. 

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `pending` | Not yet exported. |
| `exported` | Successfully exported to the accounting system. |
| `failed` | An export attempt failed and needs attention. |
exportStatus.title: exportStatus

invoiceAnalyticalSplit.description: One allocation of the whole invoice to a cost center and/or analytical-field values, as a share of its total. Splits apply to the invoice as a whole, not to individual line items.

costCenter.description: Cost center this share is allocated to, or null when the split only sets analytical-field values.

percentage.description: Percentage of the invoice allocated to this split, from 0 to 100 (e.g. `25` means 25%). The splits of an invoice add up to 100.

analyticalProperties.description: Analytical-field values set on this split.

invoiceAnalyticalSplit.title: invoiceAnalyticalSplit

invoiceAttachment.description: A file supporting the invoice (documentary evidence). An invoice may have several.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g. `application/pdf`, `application/xml` for e-invoices).

downloadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the file, valid for at most 3 hours from when it was generated. Invoice responses are cached, so a re-fetch shortly after may return the same URL — download promptly and do not persist it.

invoiceAttachment.title: invoiceAttachment

invoiceDispute.description: Details of a dispute on the invoice (contested amount, duplicate, goods/services not received, quality issue…), overlaying whatever approval/payment state the invoice holds. Not populated yet: the invoice `dispute` field is always null for now, even on an invoice in dispute with the supplier (which reports `stage` `disputed`).

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason the invoice is disputed (e.g. a standard dispute-reason code). Not enumerated — treat as an opaque, extensible code. Null when only a free-text reason exists.

reason.description: Human-readable reason/comment for the dispute, if recorded.

invoiceDispute.title: invoiceDispute

invoiceId.description: Opaque unique identifier of an invoice.
invoiceId.title: invoiceId

invoiceStage.description:
Where the invoice or credit note is in its lifecycle; exactly one value at a time. `paymentStatus` and `exportStatus` move in parallel. 

| Stage | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `pendingApproval` | Awaiting a decision in the approval workflow. |
| `inReview` | Approved, waiting for the controller review. |
| `disputed` | Approved, then put in dispute with the supplier. Invoices only. |
| `toSettle` | Reviewed. An invoice is waiting for payment, fully or in part (`paymentStatus` tells which); a credit note is partially allocated. |
| `settled` | An invoice is fully paid; a credit note is fully allocated or reimbursed. |
| `rejected` | Declined by an approver, rejected in controller review, or expired. |
| `cancelled` | Withdrawn by the company: archived after a supplier dispute, or replaced by a corrective invoice. Invoices withdrawn by their submitter are never returned. |
invoiceStage.title: invoiceStage

invoiceType.description:
Kind of document the record represents. 

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `invoice` | A supplier invoice: an amount the company owes the supplier for goods or services. Amounts are positive. |
| `creditNote` | A supplier credit note: a document from the same supplier that reduces an amount owed (a refund, cancellation, or correction of a prior invoice). Amounts are negative. |
invoiceType.title: invoiceType

lineItem.description: A single line of the invoice, with its amounts and tax. Accounting coding is set on the whole invoice (see the invoice `costCenter`, `analyticalSplits` and `expenseCategories`), not per line.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit before tax, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null when no net amount was captured, which can happen in any state (e.g. the single header-derived line of a credit note or of an older invoice whose net was never recorded).

netAmount.description: Line amount before tax (`quantity` x `unitPrice`), in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null when no net amount was captured, which can happen in any state (e.g. the single header-derived line of a credit note or of an older invoice whose net was never recorded).

taxAmount.description: Tax charged on this line, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null when no net amount was captured, which can happen in any state (e.g. the single header-derived line of a credit note or of an older invoice whose net was never recorded), or when the gross amount is not known yet.

grossAmount.description: Line amount including tax (`netAmount` + `taxAmount`), in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null when the invoice has no gross amount yet (draft/incomplete).

costCenter.description: Always null: cost centers are set on the whole invoice, see the invoice `costCenter` and `analyticalSplits`.

expenseCategory.description: Always null: expense categories are set on the whole invoice, see the invoice `expenseCategories`.

analyticalProperties.description: Always empty: analytical-field values are set on the whole invoice, see the invoice `analyticalSplits`.

lineItem.title: lineItem

payment.description: A single payment settling (or scheduled to settle) the invoice. An invoice may be settled by one or several payments — a Spendesk instalment plan, or one or more payments recorded as made outside Spendesk. `source` distinguishes the two. A failed/cancelled attempt and its retry appear as separate entries.

method.description: Means of payment, or null if not yet determined.

amount.description: Amount of this payment, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Settled (`paid`) payments in the invoice `currency` sum to the invoice `amountPaid`, except on credit notes, whose `amountPaid` is always 0 (null while `grossAmount` is unknown); a single payment may be a partial instalment.

currency.description: Currency this payment is made in — normally the invoice `currency`.

reference.description: Remittance reference sent with this payment so the supplier can reconcile it (often the supplier's payment reference or the invoice number). Null if none.

scheduledDate.description: Date the payment is scheduled to be executed. Null for externally-recorded payments that were never scheduled through Spendesk.

paidDate.description: Date the payment settled, or null if not yet settled.

statusReason.description: Why the payment failed or was returned; null for other states.

fx.description: Currency conversion applied; null when paid in the payment `currency`.

fees.description: Fees incurred on this payment (transfer, FX, intermediary…). Empty when none.

payment.title: payment

paymentFee.description: A fee incurred on the payment (deducted from the transfer or billed alongside it).

type.description: Kind of fee — `transfer` (bank/rail fee), `fx` (currency-conversion fee/spread), `intermediary` (correspondent-bank fee on international transfers), or `other`.

paymentFee.title: paymentFee

paymentFx.description: Currency conversion for this payment. Present only when the money actually moved in a currency different from the payment `currency`; null otherwise. The payment `amount`/`currency` are the invoice-side figures; these are the settlement side (what actually left the paying account).

settlementCurrency.description: Currency actually debited from the paying account.

settlementAmount.description: Amount actually moved, in `settlementCurrency`'s smallest unit.

rate.description: Exchange rate applied, such that `settlementAmount` is approximately `amount x rate` (units of `settlementCurrency` per one unit of the payment `currency`).

paymentFx.title: paymentFx

paymentMethod.description: Means of payment. Extensible — new methods may be added over time, so treat unknown values defensively. `other` is a catch-all.
paymentMethod.title: paymentMethod

paymentSource.description:
Who executed the payment. 

| Source | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spendesk` | Orchestrated and executed through Spendesk (scheduled, confirmed, transferred). |
| `external` | Happened outside Spendesk (own bank, cash, another tool) and is recorded here for reporting/bookkeeping. External payments have no Spendesk orchestration. |
paymentSource.title: paymentSource

paymentState.description:
State of a single payment (see `paymentStatus` for the invoice-level settlement aggregate). Spendesk-executed payments (`source: spendesk`) traverse the full lifecycle; externally-recorded payments (`source: external`) are typically created directly as `paid`. 

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduled` | Planned for a date but not yet confirmed; no money has moved (Spendesk only). |
| `confirmed` | Approved for release by the account owner via Strong Customer Authentication (SCA); the transfer is mandated and will be executed on the scheduled date (Spendesk only). |
| `executing` | The transfer has been sent and is in flight at the bank (Spendesk only). |
| `paid` | Executed and settled. Not necessarily terminal — a settled payment can later become `returned`. |
| `failed` | The transfer was rejected or failed before settling; see `statusReason`. A retry is a new payment entry (Spendesk only). |
| `cancelled` | A scheduled payment was cancelled before execution; no money moved. |
| `returned` | The payment had settled but the funds were later returned/clawed back by the bank (e.g. an ACH return or recall); see `statusReason`. Its amount is removed from the invoice's `amountPaid`. |
paymentState.title: paymentState

paymentStatus.description:
Settlement state, independent of where the money moved (Spendesk or elsewhere) and of `stage`. On a single invoice with `payments`, it is aggregated over settled (`paid`) payments in the invoice `currency` only; on the invoice list, on credit notes (which have no stored payment status, so always report `unpaid`), and when `payments` is empty, it is the stored payment status instead, so the list and the single invoice can disagree and the `amountPaid` conditions below hold only for the aggregated case. Scheduling and per-transfer failures are visible on individual payments, not here. 

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `unpaid` | Nothing has settled (`amountPaid` equals 0). |
| `partiallyPaid` | Some but not all has settled (`0 < amountPaid < grossAmount`). |
| `paid` | Fully settled (`amountDue` equals 0), by any means. |

A `returned` payment reduces `amountPaid`, so this can move back from `paid` to `partiallyPaid` or `unpaid`.
paymentStatus.title: paymentStatus

paymentStatusReason.description: Why a payment failed or was returned. Present for those states; null otherwise.

code.description: Machine-readable reason/return code (e.g. an ACH return code like `R01`, or a bank rejection code). Opaque and extensible; null when only a message is available.

paymentStatusReason.title: paymentStatusReason

priceAmount.description:
If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency.
Can contain a negative value in case of refunds.
Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).
priceAmount.title: priceAmount

purchaseOrderRef.description: Reference to a purchase order the invoice is matched against (two/three-way match).
purchaseOrderRef.title: purchaseOrderRef

review.description: Finance/controller review that validates the invoice's data (amounts, coding, documentary evidence) for accounting. Distinct from `approval`, which authorises the spend — this checks the booking data. Null on the invoice when no review has been recorded.
review.title: review

supplierRef.description: Reference to the supplier (counterparty) of the invoice.

id.description: Supplier id. Fetch full supplier details from `GET /v1/suppliers/{id}`.

supplierRef.title: supplierRef

taxRate.description: Tax rate as a percentage — e.g. `20` means 20%, `5.5` means 5.5%. Null when no rate applies or it is unknown.
taxRate.title: taxRate
